item.title: 【General Music Discussion】Is it worth it buying a portable DAC and high quality headphones?
item.description:
Hi everyone,

I'm interested in buying high quality audio gear to listen to the library of lossless files I've accumulated. I've never really had "good" headphones, just consumer grade stuff and I mostly listen to music from my phone or from my laptop. I learned way too late that anything Bluetooth reduces audio quality in the transmission process, so I'm looking to get away from that. At the moment I'm using wired gaming headphones. I've never had the opportunity to listen to music with expensive gear.

So my question is; Is it worth the money to buy a DAC and high quality over ear headphones? Or will it be a situation where I'll be paying hundreds of dollars for a small increase in noticeable quality? I've heard the debate online that most people can't tell a difference between mp3 and lossless files, but I feel I can hear a difference.

Anyone who owns and uses a DAC, I'd really like your honest opinion on this. Thanks very much!
